task.title: Implement bounded agency runner
task.summary: Upgrade codewiki_agency from planner output to a bounded runner that selects work, claims scopes, invokes compiler steps, submits gateway checks, and uses CodeWiki-owned compaction within task/sprint/roadmap scope.

goal.outcome: Agency can run bounded compiler/gateway steps automatically inside approved task, sprint, or roadmap scope without bypassing hard gates.
acceptance: codewiki_agency work mode can plan and execute one safe compiler/gateway step when budgets, agency level, and approval cadence allow it.
Runner acquires and releases artifact-status claims for touched scopes and stops on conflicts, ambiguity, validation blocks, risk escalation, destructive/publication gates, or budget exhaustion.
Runner uses codewiki_resume_context and CodeWiki-owned compaction/session-boundary kickoff at safe boundaries when context reset is needed.
Workflow-efficiency evidence records user interruptions avoided/required, manual commands avoided, session boundaries used, and platform-limited steps.
Existing agency source-root, compaction, and resume scheduler behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not spawn parallel workers in this task; scheduler/worktree work owns that.
Do not bypass decision/planning/implementation validation gates.
Do not perform destructive, publication, push, or release actions automatically.
verification: new agency runner tests for stop gates and budget limits

delta.desired: Agency orchestrates routine compiler/gateway progression inside explicit limits while preserving hard gates.
delta.current: codewiki_agency mostly reports next steps and stop gates; agents still manually sequence compilers and gateways.
delta.closure: Task closes when runner tests prove allowed steps execute and blocked steps stop with clear evidence.
